root_cause.text: The `xe_pagefault_service` function in the DRM/xe driver lacked validation logic to prevent write or atomic memory accesses on virtual memory areas (VMAs) that were configured as read-only.
root_cause.evidence: The patch inserts a check `if (xe_vma_read_only(vma) && pf->consumer.access_type != XE_PAGEFAULT_ACCESS_TYPE_READ)` into `xe_pagefault_service` to reject invalid access types, aligning with the CVE description stating the page fault handler should reject write/atomic access to read-only VMAs.

intent_record.intent_summary: Enforces read-only VMA constraints by rejecting non-read access requests during page fault servicing.
intent_record.what: Inserted a conditional check verifying if the VMA is read-only while the requested access type is not read, setting an error code and jumping to cleanup if true.
intent_record.how: Prevents write operations on read-only memory regions by returning -EPERM during page fault processing before atomic access checks occur.
